column1: # Golden summary for 'plane-grid' - E11-T11. Generated; do not hand-edit.
# Rewrite it with SPARK_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1, then READ THE DIFF before committing it.
# Every row but the last is rounded to ten decimal places and is meant to be compared by
# eye. `hash` is over the EXACT BITS of the canonical detail - every vertex, every control
# point - so a hash that moves while every other row holds means the shape changed below
# the printed precision: a reordered vertex, an inserted knot, rearranged arithmetic.
# The fixture is built from exact arithmetic only. Sin, Cos and Pow are not guaranteed
# bit-identical across platforms and a hash has no tolerance, so no sphere, cone, arc or
# circle is a golden fixture here.
